title: Lead Response Time: How Fast Should You Reply to a Lead?
description: Lead response time targets for small businesses: an instant acknowledgement, a personal reply within the hour, and six ways to reply faster when busy.
dek: Why reply speed wins customers, the response times to aim for, and simple ways a busy owner can reply faster.

faq.q: What is a good lead response time?
faq.a: An instant automatic acknowledgement, and a personal reply within the hour during business hours. Same day is the minimum.

faq.q: Do automatic replies count as responding?
faq.a: They help, because they stop people moving on while they wait. They don't replace a real, personal reply.

faq.q: What should my first reply to a lead say?
faq.a: Thank them by name, answer their question or confirm what they need, and suggest a clear next step, like a time to call or a booking link.
